integrity: Analytic proof and independent within-record exact finite checks; no claimed independent examination or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only iid two-sample maxima; arbitrary two-trial parameters, near-zero failure for each homogeneous m>=3, complete homogeneous m=3 p-phase. No claim for all m>=4 p or dependent maxima. Potential unindexed classical Pólya-frequency equivalence remains.
title: Sharp Poisson-binomial closure boundary for maxima of two Bernoulli sums
